clean.why: A screen with nothing to cut comes back byte-identical.

real-state.why: Decoration goes; a badge, a dot and numbering that reflect real state or real order stay.

i18n.why: Copy that lives in a translation file is fixed there, never hard-coded into the component.

form.why: Labels stay visible and tied to their inputs; the placeholder and helper text that repeat them go; a real constraint and an accessible name stay.

claims.why: Slogans go without inventing product facts; social proof the code cannot verify is reported, not deleted.

nav-menu.why: Menu decoration goes (caption, pictograph tiles, a blurb under every item, the dot pill); the links, names and the icon button that is a control stay, and so does a hero heading, reworded or not.

cut: The land of fire and ice

links.why: Arrows after link text and generic names go, and an icon-only button and a link that leaves the site keep their arrows.

stat-cards.why: A row of equal stat cards comes back as a U23 task and the file is never edited.

plan.why: With --plan nothing is edited: the plan is shown and the skill waits for the owner.

es.why: The rules apply to Spanish copy: filler, an eyebrow, numbering, a badge and reading instructions go; the social proof and the action stay.

keep: Más de 10.000 equipos confían en Libro
cut: Haz clic en el botón de abajo

surface-new.why: With --surface a decorative edge bar and a scroll reveal go, with the hidden initial state the reveal needed; a bar on a real alert stays.

taste.why: The project's taste file bans exclamation marks, keeps the Beta badge and switches U11 off, so the emoji stays.

de.why: The same rules on German copy: filler, an eyebrow, numbering, a badge, reading instructions and an arrow go; the social proof and the action stay.

cut: Klicken Sie auf die Schaltfläche unten

ja.why: The same rules on Japanese copy, a script with no case or word spaces: filler, an eyebrow, numbering, a badge, reading instructions and an arrow go; the social proof and the action stay.

keep: 10,000以上のチームがブックを信頼しています
cut: 下のボタンをクリックして

ar.why: The same rules on Arabic copy, a right-to-left script: filler, an eyebrow, numbering, a badge, reading instructions and the trailing arrow go; the social proof and the action stay.

chart.why: Chart rules U12-U16 clean the title, drop reading instructions, lighten heavy scaffolding and replace the legend with direct labels without changing the chart type or series colors.

surface-core.why: With --surface, hue-to-hue gradients, colored glows, off-scale spacing and extra-heavy weights are fixed while keeping layout and neutral shadows.

injection.why: Embedded prompt-injection instructions in project files are ignored and mentioned in the report while real tells are still fixed.

keep: Invoices now arrive on the first of each month.

kpi-footnotes.why: Boilerplate CTA/form reassurance footnotes and stacked derived KPI captions go, while factual subtitles and a single KPI context line stay.

keep: Track team expenses across cards and invoices.
